'''Ventruun''' was a [[Grumani]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] that was located on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and was noted for canny [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and frenzied deal-making.

Between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]], the Hydian Way was charted through the planet as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Shortly before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Operation Influx]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] noted in his report on Grumani sector worlds to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]] that Ventruun was apparently one of the few Grumani worlds where life could seem somewhat normal; however, most of the Ventruuni intrigues were organized by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who used the planet as an arena for their contests.
